'''Hodi''' was an astronomical object located in the [[Core Worlds]], situated along the [[Corellian Run]]<ref name="Map" /> in the [[Hodi system]],<ref name="Appendix" /> that was part of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[2 BBY]], it was represented in the [[Imperial Senate]] on [[Coruscant]] by [[Senior Senator]] [[Erveen]].

==Behind the scenes==
Hodi was first mentioned in "[[Welcome to the Rebellion]]," the ninth episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" /> on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
